'''Obsidian Squadron''' was an elite [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Stationed aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], the squadron was led by [[Civé Rashon/Legends|Civé Rashon]], and was composed of modified [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] mostly used to pursue raiders through [[Planet/Legends|planets']] upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Obsidian Squadron was present on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during its [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The squadron's [[TIE pilot]]s pursued the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] escape from the planet into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], although ultimately Obsidian Squadron was unable to capture the ''Millennium Falcon''. Obsidian Squadron would later participate in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ended in an Imperial defeat and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroying the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==History==
===Imperial TIE/LN starfighter squadron===
[[File:Obsidian10-CCGDS2.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Obsidian Squadron was a squadron of TIE/LN starfighters.]]
Obsidian Squadron was an elite [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] serving in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The squadron was stationed aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].<ref name="CCG-OS721" /> At least one of the squadron's [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] was stationed aboard<ref name="CCG-Obsidian10" /> the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="CSWE Thunderflare">{{CSWECite|III|242|''Thunderflare''}}</ref> ''[[Thunderflare]]''.<ref name="CCG-Obsidian10" />

At some point during the Galactic Civil War, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] located an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] holonet [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] network, which was critical for maintaining [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide secret communications. [[TIE pilot]]s from Obsidian and [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron]] attacked the Alliance network, intending to get close enough to download and decipher the encrypted Alliance transmissions.<ref name="Dark Whispers">{{StoryCite|story=Mission 3: Dark Whispers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set|bformatted=''Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game'' Core Set}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Mission 3: Dark Whispers}}
Both the Black Squadron and Obsidian Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the defending [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] of [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. The Alliance further implemented security safeguards to lock down their transmissions, disabling the holonet network but keeping the data safe.<ref name="Dark Whispers" />
{{Endgame}}

===Occupying Bespin and Battle of Endor===
[[File:RarrExecutorSMASH-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|left|320px|Obsidian Squadron pursuing the ''Millennium Falcon'' outside Bespin]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Empire [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] with the intention of capturing the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] on the planet.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Prior to the Imperial occupation, several of Obsidian Squadron's TIE/LN starfighters were already assigned to patrol Bespin's [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], with instructions to herd escaping [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] toward the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],<ref name="CCG:CCL">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=TIE Sentry Ships}}</ref> the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] overseeing the pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Ultimately, the ''Falcon'' escape Cloud City, and Obsidian Squadron's TIE/LN starfighters pursued the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]],<ref name="ESB" /> with several of them being destroyed when the ''Falcon'' fought back.<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> Obsidian Squadron's pursuit of the ''Falcon'' continued into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], with the squadron chasing the ''Falcon'' towards the ''Executor'', before the freighter ultimately escaped Imperial capture.<ref name="ESB" />

One [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] occurred, during which the Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]<ref name="NEC" /> in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Obsidian Squadron participated in the battle,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|81|Rashon, Civé}}</ref> which ended in an Imperial defeat and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] destruction.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Organization==
[[File:Obsidian_Squadron_Pilot_XWM.png|thumb|right|150px|An Obsidian Squadron pilot flying through an asteroid field]]
Obsidian Squadron was composed of modified TIE/LN starfighters mostly used to chase raiders through the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of planets,<ref name="CSWE OS">{{CSWECite|II|402|Obsidian Squadron}}</ref> and specially adapted for atmospheric engagement. Some of Obsidian Squadron's TIE/LN starfighters were also fitted with high-output [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panels]] to support improved weaponry.<ref name="CCG-ObsidianTIE">{{CCG|set=Official Tournament Sealed Deck|cardname=Obsidian Squadron TIE}}</ref>

==Members==
Obsidian Squadron was led by [[Civé Rashon/Legends|Civé Rashon]]. She flew the TIE/LN starfighter [[Obsidian 1]] and further had the designation "OS-72-1."<ref name="CCG-OS721" /> Her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] was [[Dodson Makraven/Legends|Dodson Makraven]], a TIE pilot who flew the TIE/LN starfighter [[Obsidian 2]] and was further designated "OS-72-2."<ref name="CCG-Makraven">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=OS-72-2 In Obsidian 2}}</ref>

[[File:Obsidian_1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Civé Rashon was the lead TIE pilot of Obsidian Squadron.]]
Obsidian Squadron's pilots during the Occupation of Bespin included [[Winged Gundark]]<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> flying [[Obsidian 7]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Obsidian 7}}</ref> and [[OS-72-8]]<ref name="BTM" /> flying [[Obsidian 8]].<ref name="CCG-Obsidian8">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Obsidian 8}}</ref> Both of those members were among the TIE pilots pursuing the ''Millennium Falcon'' out of Bespin, and their starfighters were also designated as "Obsidian Seven" and "Obsidian Eight."<ref name="BTM" />

By 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[OS-72-10]] was a member of Obsidian Squadron, flying [[Obsidian 10]],<ref name="OScard">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=OS-72-10}}</ref> a TIE/LN starfighter which was stationed aboard the ''Thunderflare''. Obsidian 10 was recalled to defend the Death Star II during its construction by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of<ref name="CCG-Obsidian10" /> the Battle of Endor, which Civé Rashon and other members of the squadron participated in.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obsidian Squadron first appeared in<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> the [[April 12]], [[1980]]<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref><ref name="Amazon-RandomHouse">{{Amazon|url=Empire-Strikes-Back-Storybook/dp/0394844149|text=The Empire Strikes Back Storybook}} {{C|US hardcover}}</ref> [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]] of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]] film {{Film|V}},<ref name="ESB novel" /> simultaneously with ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]'',<ref name="ESB storybook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''</ref> before making an appearance in the film,<ref name="ESB" /> which was released [[May 21]] of the same year.<ref name="Empire Turns 40">{{ThisWeek|6UccH037VQ0|The Empire Strikes Back Turns 40, Queen's Peril Gets a Voice, and More!|sw_url=video/the-empire-strikes-back-turns-40-queen-s-peril-gets-a-voice-and-more}}</ref> In [[1997]], [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Cloud City Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] released cards coining the "Obsidian 7"<ref name="CCG" /> and "Obsidian 8" TIE fighter designations, although it was not obvious if either of the starfighters was in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.<ref name="CCG-Obsidian8" />

In [[May]] [[1998]],<ref name="Decipher">{{Decipher|url=starwars/whatisit/timeline.html|text=''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game Product Timeline}}</ref> the squadron was first named on a card for the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's ''[[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]]'' expansion set,<ref name="CCG-ObsidianTIE" /> and on [[September 1]] the same year,<ref name="Cargo">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/719|text=Star Wars: Behind the Magic}}</ref> the CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' established that Obsidian 7 and Obsidian 8 appeared in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.<ref name="BTM" /> Obsidian Squadron was also featured in [[2012]]'s ''[[Mission 3: Dark Whispers]]'', a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]] scenario written for the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]'' and published as a rules supplement in the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set]]''. There is more than one possible outcome for that combat scenario. The outcome presented in the article is the one assumed to be [[canon]]. Other possible endings are the Alliance starfighters destroying their satellites to prevent the Empire from downloading their data, or at least one of the Imperial starfighters downloading and escaping with the Alliance satellite network's data.<ref name="Dark Whispers" />
